answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. Audits are published in basalt, queued in spiral, and inlet publishes the wait time. A farm of 330 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2216 identities would post 2198 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
